question.problem: The lamina $D=\{(x,y)\,:\,0\le y\le x,\,0\le x\le 1\}$ has the mass density function $\lambda (x,y)=3xy.$ Find the moment of the lamina about the $x$-axis.
question.worked_solution:
The moment of a lamina $D$ with the mass density function $\lambda (x,y)$ about the $x$-axis is given by

$$
{M}_{x}={∬}_{D}y\,\lambda (x,y)\,\text{d}A.
$$

In our case, $D$ is represented as a type I plane region and $\lambda (x,y)=3xy.$ 

Therefore, the moment is

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{x} & ={∬}_{D}y\cdot 3xy\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}3x{y}^{2}\,\text{d}A \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{x}3x{y}^{2}\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}x\cdot {[{y}^{3}]}_{y=0}^{y=x}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}x\cdot {x}^{3}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{x}^{4}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={[\frac{1}{5}{x}^{5}]}_{x=0}^{x=1} \\  & =\frac{1}{5}.\end{aligned}
$$
